# KiddyTube Android install

Sideload this file on an Android phone, tablet, or TV (Android 6.0+).

- **[Download APK](KiddyTube-2.1.0.apk)** (13 MB, version 2.1.0)
- Phone-friendly page: [index.html](index.html)

## On your phone

1. Open [KiddyTube-2.1.0.apk](KiddyTube-2.1.0.apk) in Chrome
2. Allow installs from the browser if Android asks
3. Tap **Install**, then open **KiddyTube**

This is a debug sideload build (not from Play Store). Parent PIN: `2580`.
